title: AutoBot: robotic optimization of halide perovskites
summary: A closed loop with robotics and Bayesian optimization explored a four-parameter synthesis space of over 5,000 combinations, and the model made predictions after sampling less than 1%; humidity during deposition was the most influential factor. This is process optimization, not a new material; the page gives no accuracy figure.

evidence.tested: A closed loop of robotic synthesis and Bayesian optimization explored over 5,000 combinations, and predictions were validated with manual and in situ photoluminescence measurements.
evidence.unknown: The page gives no model accuracy metrics and no explicit limitations; the wider application to other semiconductors is forward-looking.
evidence.ai_role: Bayesian optimization chose which experiments to run and identified humidity as the most influential factor after sampling under 1% of the space.
